verified: GreyNoise says it tracked an intrusion campaign against Check Point Security Management Servers, with confirmed activity from October 17 to November 2, 2026, affecting at least 22 organizations globally; Cybersecurity Dive and SecurityWeek relayed the report.
unconfirmed: The supplied reports contain no Check Point statement confirming the intrusions, the 22-victim count, or GreyNoise's AI-enabled characterization; the initial access vector is unresolved, with community commenters speculating about an internet-exposed management server and a specific CVE, and SecurityWeek describes the campaign as likely ongoing beyond GreyNoise's confirmed window.

verified: GreyNoise 报告称，2026 年 10 月 17 日至 11 月 2 日期间确认存在针对 Check Point 安全管理服务器（Security Management Server）的攻击活动，全球至少 22 家不同机构受影响；上述结论来自 GreyNoise 自行发布的博客，SecurityWeek 与 Cybersecurity Dive 均转述了这份报告。
unconfirmed: 攻击者的身份、所谓“AI 赋能/AI 辅助”的具体程度、初始入口是否为 CVE-2026-16232、以及攻击活动目前是否仍在持续，均只有 GreyNoise 一家之说；目前未见 Check Point 的确认或回应，也没有独立机构复现攻击，或公布受影响机构名单。

titles.en: GreyNoise tracks active intrusion campaign against Check Point management servers
titles.zh: GreyNoise 称 Check Point 安全管理服务器正遭活跃入侵
